beats.html:
No child has been killed by a
stranger's poisoned
Halloween candy.

A sociologist named Joel Best
has tracked every report
since 1958.

A fear that changed how a
country parents has
nothing behind it.

clip.match_reason: The fact is the Halloween poisoned candy scare, and the plate is a 1970s front porch on Halloween night with a bowl of wrapped candy left out under one light and nobody watching it.
